protocol.selection: independent medians of three complete runs on each host
protocol.variation_flags: max/min - 1 > 0.15, and separately any absolute relative deviation from median > 0.15
protocol.M2_gate: no SMHasher3 process and 1-minute load <4.5 before every run
protocol.bulk_ratio: fixed bytes/cycle divided by control bytes/cycle; above 1 is faster
protocol.small_ratio: fixed cycles/hash divided by control cycles/hash; above 1 is slower
protocol.cycle_caveat: Xeon RDTSC/RDTSCP; M2 calibrated monotonic-clock cycle estimate. Printed GiB/s assumes 3.5 GHz, not measured frequency.
